templates.title: Average takings
templates.prompt_md: The list `week` holds @@n@@ days of café takings, in pounds. Work out the average takings per day and store it in a variable called `average`.
hints: Add the list up with `sum(week)`, then divide by how many items there are: `len(week)`.
wrong_examples:
week = @@week@@
average = sum(week)
week = @@week@@
average = sum(week) / (len(week) - 1)
alternative_solutions:
week = @@week@@
total = 0
for day in week:
    total += day
average = total / len(week)
